parameters.query:
SELECT v.cve_id, v.asset_id, v.cvss_v3, v.epss_score, v.composite_score,
       v.attack_vector, a.hostname, a.environment, a.criticality,
       a.owner_team
FROM vulnerabilities v
JOIN cmdb_assets a ON v.asset_id=a.asset_id
WHERE v.status='open' AND v.priority_tier IN ('P1-Critical','P2-High')
ORDER BY v.composite_score DESC
LIMIT 100;
